(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising the steps of: accessing a first server computer through a path in a computer network; the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The system for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer; a computer network; a locator of a resource on the second server computer; circuitry for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers to the locator; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: The computer program product for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: program code for accessing a first server computer through a path in a computer network; program code for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer; program code for the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and program code for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.
